entities.name: Benoît Puga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Benoît Marie Puga is a retired general in the French Army and former Grand Chancellor of the National Order of the Legion of Honour and the National Order of Merit (2016–2023). He previously served as Director of Military Intelligence (2008–2010) and Chief of the Military Staff of the President of the Republic (2010–2016).

entities.name: Benoît Puga
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Benoît Marie Puga is a retired general in the French Army and former Grand Chancellor of the National Order of the Legion of Honour and the National Order of Merit (2016–2023). He previously served as Director of Military Intelligence (2008–2010) and Chief of the Military Staff of the President of the Republic (2010–2016).
